pending_gate.summary: Root cause for ecom-content-stack: local-profile defaults for content-stack-service and content-stack-entry-service base-url incorrectly use …/v3/test (Demo commit), so unset CONTENTSTACK_* env vars send clients to invalid ContentStack paths; 4xx is then correctly mapped to ECS_40001 by defaultBadRequestError(). Bug condition C = local profile + those env defaults applying. Proposed fix = restore …/v3 on those two yaml defaults only. Scope fence unchanged from Gate 1.
